decisions.why: Symbios's own site files this division under 'Hanche' (French: Hip); its five products (SERENITY, APRIL, HARMONY, SPS, INDIVIDUAL HIP) are named hip implant systems, matching the Total Orthopaedic Solutions 3 'implant' type.
Symbios's own site files this division under 'Genou' (French: Knee); its one product (ORIGIN) is a named knee implant system, matching the Total Orthopaedic Solutions 3 'implant' type.
